propositions: Eval harnesses currently hard-code repository paths under docs/experiments/ and must be refactored to expose configurable corpus roots for client projects

evals_corpus_root() must be the single resolution point for replay cache, replay output, ledger, and project eval-spec roots, with default <repo_root>/.rebar/evals and configured override via rebar.toml
Research corpus tree docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/ must be moved to top-level evals/ directory and excluded from wheel and sdist packages
All hard-coded references to docs/experiments must be eliminated from src/rebar/llm/evals except one docstring, verified by grep and unit tests

Client projects must be able to run plan replay, fixture mining, and provider parity harnesses after rebar init plus .rebar/evals/*.eval.yaml, documented with pip install nava-rebar[evals] and evals extra registered
User guide must document the three client-runnable eval harness commands and close 71 orphaned fixture-drift tasks as obsolete
